items.source: Shortcut for resolve(List, MessageSource, Locale) with an empty MessageSource that simply formats the default message, or first error code, also prepending the field name for field errors.
items.translation: 用于 `resolve(List, MessageSource, Locale)` 的快捷方式，其包含一个空的MessageSource，该快捷方式仅格式化默认消息或第一个错误代码，并且对于字段错误会附加字段名称。

items.source: Shortcut for resolveAndJoin(List, MessageSource, Locale) with an empty MessageSource that simply formats the default message, or first error code, also prepending the field name for field errors.
items.translation: 用于 `resolveAndJoin(List, MessageSource, Locale)` 的快捷方式，该快捷方式使用一个空的 MessageSource 来简单地格式化默认消息或第一个错误代码，并且对于字段错误会附加字段名称。

items.source: Shortcut for resolveAndJoin(CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence, List, MessageSource, Locale) with ", and " as delimiter, and an empty prefix and suffix.
items.translation: `resolveAndJoin(CharSequence, CharSequence, CharSequence, List, MessageSource, Locale)` 的快捷方式，使用 `", and "` 作为分隔符，且前缀和后缀为空。

items.source: Resolve all errors through the given MessageSource.
items.translation: 通过给定的MessageSource解决所有错误。

items.source: Resolve all errors through the given MessageSource and join them.
items.translation: 通过给定的MessageSource解析所有错误并将它们连接起来。

items.source: Utility methods to resolve a list of MessageSourceResolvables, and optionally join them.
items.translation: 用于解析一组MessageSourceResolvable的实用方法，并可选择将它们连接起来。

items.source: locale - the locale to resolve with an empty MessageSource
items.translation: `locale` - 用于在空MessageSource中解析的区域设置

items.source: delimiter - the delimiter to use between each error
items.translation: delimiter - 每个错误之间使用的分隔符

items.source: prefix - characters to insert at the beginning
suffix - characters to insert at the end
errors - the errors to resolve and join
the resolved errors formatted as a string
items.translation: 以字符串格式显示的已解析错误

items.source: map with resolved errors as values, in the order of the input list
items.translation: 包含已解析错误的映射，顺序与输入列表一致。
